statement.p: Calculate the flux of the vector field \vec F = 4\,\mathit{\vec i}-5\,\mathit{\vec j}+4\,\mathit{\vec k} through a cube of side 4 with sides parallel to the axes.
Suppose that one face of the cube is at z=0 and the opposite face is at z=4. If the face at z=0 is removed, what is the flux through the resulting surface?

static.solution:
\mbox{Flux}=0. The flux through opposite faces of the cube cancel.
If we remove the side of the cube at z=0, then the flux through the opposite face of the cube is no longer cancelled. For this face we have \vec A = 16 \vec k, so that \mbox{Flux } = (4\,\mathit{\vec i}-5\,\mathit{\vec j}+4\,\mathit{\vec k})\cdot (16\vec k) = 64.
